program.section_heading: PALO ALTO NETWORKS SECURITY OPERATIONS AND AUTOMATION SPECIALIST
outcomes: Students will demonstrate advanced cybersecurity skills by configuring next-generation firewalls, automating cloud security workflows, and integrating AI/ML-driven solutions to enhance threat detection, incident response, and overall enterprise protection.

Students will apply architectural and automation principles to design secure, scalable enterprise environments, implement zero-trust strategies, and leverage SIEM- and SOAR-based solutions to streamline threat intelligence and strengthen Security Operations Center (SOC) capabilities.

Students will evaluate and implement proactive security strategies that integrate advanced tools, best practices, and emerging technologies to maintain resilient, efficient, and ethically responsible cybersecurity operations across diverse organizational environments

notes: Certificate of Completion (Noncredit), State Code 46443. The catalog prints no hours or units for the courses or the program, so all units fields are null. Measure is left as 'units' because the text does not state hours, although this is a noncredit program.
Outcome 2 breaks the line after 'zero-'; I recorded it as 'zero-trust' (a hyphenated compound), not 'zero- trust'.
Outcome 3 has no closing period in the catalog; it is copied as printed.

The career entry 'professional cybersecurity roles' comes from the program description ('pursue professional cybersecurity roles or industry-recognized certifications'). A reviewer may want to confirm it counts as a career field.
Adjacent sections for Palo Alto Networks Cybersecurity Fundamentals (VOC ED 713CE-715CE) and Splunk Security Operations Analyst (VOC ED 710CE-712CE) were ignored.
